understanding.purpose: マンション管理規約の主要な項目、定めの内容、違反時の対応を対応づけて示す。
understanding.reading: 左端の項目から関心のある行を探し、内容と違反時の対応を横に読み比べる。行内の長い文章は折り返されるため、各行がまとまりとして追いやすい幅配分が必要。
groups: 「内容」と「違反時の対応」は、各項目について読者が続けて確認する説明文の列であり、どちらにも十分な幅が必要。
「項目」は各行を識別する見出しで、説明文とは役割が異なるが、長い項目名もある。
keep_intact: 「違反時の対応」などの列見出し
項目名や本文中の意味のまとまり、数字・記号を伴う表記
may_wrap: 長い項目名は意味の切れ目で折り返せる。
内容と違反時の対応の文章は自然に折り返せる。片方の説明が長く行が高くなる場合、もう一方の折り返しもその高さに収まりうる。

bad.why: The row-header column would have only 29 px of text space, forcing long Japanese topic labels into narrow fragments and making it difficult to identify and scan rows. The wider content column would not compensate for losing that orientation.

contrast.why: The row-header column would have only 29 px of text space, forcing long Japanese topic labels into narrow fragments and making it difficult to identify and scan rows. The wider content column would not compensate for losing that orientation.

final.rationale: r3A gives the long rule descriptions enough width to read in reasonably continuous phrases while retaining space for the corresponding responses. Its row labels remain distinct and scannable, and the two prose columns produce a relatively even rhythm across the six rows. The table is still very tall on a phone, but all three headers fit and the reported rendering has no mid-word splits.

general: Give row identifiers enough width to remain useful as scanning anchors.
Allocate space according to the length and role of each column, then judge how the cells read together within each row.
A shorter table is useful only when the width distribution still supports reading and comparison.
specific: The content column carries the most text and benefits from the largest share of the 359 px budget.
The response column also contains substantial prose, so it needs more space than the row-header column.
All supplied candidates fit the headers and report no mid-word splits; their differences are chiefly in line breaks, row rhythm and the balance between the three columns.

final.tradeoffs: r1C gives the topic labels more room but narrows the response column; r3C gives the content column more room but makes the labels more fragmented. A designer may prefer either balance depending on whether finding a topic or reading its detailed rule is the primary task.
final.uncertain: The ranges are approximate judgments based on the supplied renders, not tested guarantees for every width combination. They describe individual adjustments with the remaining width redistributed proportionally; the endpoints should not be combined independently.

A.why: 内容列に十分な幅があり、対応列との対応関係も追いやすい。項目名はやや細かく折り返される。

B.why: 本文二列の幅は比較的均衡しているが、項目名の折り返しが多く、内容列も細かく途切れる。

C.why: 項目名がAよりまとまって読みやすく、内容と対応も追える。対応列はやや狭く、長い文章の折り返しが多い。

D.why: 項目名がほぼ一文字ずつ縦に並び、行の識別が難しい。対応列も狭く、行内に大きな空白が生じている。

E.why: 内容と対応は比較的読みやすいが、項目列が狭く、見出し語が細かく分断される。

F.why: 項目名はまとまる一方、内容と対応の両列が狭く、本文が頻繁に折り返されて比較しづらい。

reviews.unsure: AとCは近い。Cは項目名を追いやすい一方、Aは対応列に少し余裕があるため、本文と行見出しのどちらを重視するかで評価が変わりうる。

A.why: The row labels have enough width to remain identifiable, and the larger 内容 column suits its longer text. The response column is somewhat narrow, producing dense wrapping.

B.why: The very narrow row-header column breaks labels into short fragments, making it hard to find and scan topics, even though the two text columns have more room.

C.why: The columns give the longer 内容 text more space while retaining a recognizable row-header column. The response text is fairly cramped and the labels wrap often.

D.why: Row labels are reduced almost to a character per line, and the narrow response column also wraps heavily. Large blank areas in 内容 weaken the row rhythm.

E.why: The wide row-header column keeps labels clearer, but leaves both long text columns too narrow. Frequent wrapping makes the table very tall and wastes space below the labels.

F.why: The two prose columns have a useful balance, so both rules and responses are reasonably readable. Row labels wrap frequently but remain distinguishable, and rows hold together well.

reviews.unsure: A and C are close alternatives; the choice depends on whether the extra space for row labels and 内容 outweighs F's more comfortable response column.
